Oscar Lindgren  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 50 123 4567 | oscar.lindgren@email.com | linkedin.com/in/oscar-lindgren  

As a Site Reliability Engineer at MedTech Innovations, I focus on bridging development and operations to ensure scalable, secure, and reliable systems for healthcare applications. My work spans infrastructure automation, observability, and cost management, with a strong emphasis on aligning technical solutions with business needs. Over the past three years, I’ve contributed to deploying critical patient monitoring platforms and optimizing cloud infrastructure for a 500+ employee startup. My approach combines hands-on engineering with a collaborative mindset to resolve complex challenges in high-stakes environments.  

At MedTech Innovations, I lead the deployment and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters supporting real-time diagnostic tools, ensuring 99.95% SLA compliance. I designed a CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins and GitHub Actions to streamline updates for medical devices, reducing deployment latency by 40%. I also implemented Prometheus and Grafana for end-to-end monitoring, enabling proactive issue resolution. Cloud cost optimization is a key focus, with initiatives like AWS Spot Instance utilization and Terraform-managed resource tagging cutting infrastructure expenses by 15%.  

Previously, at MedTech Systems, I transitioned from DevOps to SRE, focusing on improving system resilience. I architected an ArgoCD-based GitOps workflow for microservices, simplifying environment management across staging and production. My work on Linux system hardening and secure Docker containerization reduced security vulnerabilities in critical health data pipelines. I also collaborated with the security team to integrate monitoring with SIEM tools, enhancing incident detection capabilities.  

At HealthTech Solutions, I began my career by automating infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, reducing manual setup time for new projects. I contributed to a Python-based tool for analyzing cloud billing data, identifying underutilized resources and saving thousands in unnecessary costs. My early work on CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins laid the foundation for more advanced automation strategies in subsequent roles.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
AWS: Deployed scalable infrastructure for medical imaging systems, managed EC2 and RDS clusters, and optimized cost structures through spot instances and reserved instances.  
ArgoCD: Automated deployment workflows for microservices, enabling seamless environment transitions and reducing manual intervention in production.  
CI/CD pipelines: Built and maintained Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines for healthcare software, ensuring rapid and reliable updates for diagnostic platforms.  
Cloud cost optimization: Analyzed billing data to identify cost savings opportunities, implemented tagging strategies, and reduced overprovisioning in Kubernetes clusters.  
Docker: Containerized critical health data processing workflows, ensuring consistent environments across development and production.  
GitHub Actions: Integrated automated testing and deployment for medical device firmware updates, improving release reliability.  
Jenkins: Automated build and deployment processes for legacy systems, reducing deployment errors by 30%.  
Kubernetes: Managed orchestration for real-time patient monitoring tools, ensuring high availability and scalability.  
Linux administration: Maintained secure and performant server environments, including firewall configurations and system performance tuning.  
Monitoring & alerting: Implemented Prometheus/Grafana dashboards for observability, enabling proactive troubleshooting in mission-critical applications.  
Python: Developed scripts for cloud cost analysis and data pipeline automation, streamlining operational workflows.  
Terraform: Automated infrastructure provisioning for scalable healthcare platforms, ensuring consistent and repeatable deployments.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
- Automated infrastructure audit tool using Python and AWS CloudTrail, identifying compliance gaps in real-time.  
- Open-source contribution to a medical data anonymization project, enhancing data privacy through secure containerization.  
- Internal tool for visualizing Kubernetes cluster resource usage, improving team efficiency in capacity planning.  
- Proof-of-concept for serverless architecture in a diagnostic imaging pipeline, reducing latency by 25% in testing.
